question: Using only the data from the ‘results’ table, find the three years in which the sum of the highest total points earned by any driver and the highest total points earned by any constructor in that year (both calculated by summing up points from the ‘results’ table) is smallest, and list those three years in order of ascending total.
sql:
-- Step 3: Build the full query to find the 3 years with smallest combined total
WITH driver_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, driver_id, SUM(results.points) as driver_total_points
    FROM results
    JOIN races r ON results.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, driver_id
),
constructor_totals AS (
    SELECT r.year, constructor_id, SUM(results.points) as constructor_total_points
    FROM results
    JOIN races r ON results.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, constructor_id
),
max_driver_by_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(driver_total_points) as max_driver_points
    FROM driver_totals
    GROUP BY year
),
max_constructor_by_year AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(constructor_total_points) as max_constructor_points
    FROM constructor_totals
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
    md.year,
    md.max_driver_points + mc.max_constructor_points as combined_total
FROM max_driver_by_year md
JOIN max_constructor_by_year mc ON md.year = mc.year
ORDER BY combined_total ASC
LIMIT 3
